title: A season's final results (draft 0.1.0)
description: What players' final results say about each server once a raid has closed (solo_raid_predict #63). The private engine writes it to the outbox as finals/s<n>.json from the raid's close on. Until settles_at it carries only how many results are in: no number, so nothing on the page can be copied back as a final result. After it, each server's 3% line for the season, and its curve and tier table once there are enough results near 3%. All damage in 0.1B.

settles_at.description: When the season's results are shown: a fixed time after the raid's close, once the in-game ranking can no longer change.

settled.description: Whether settles_at had passed when the engine wrote this document. false: the servers carry counts only.

players.description: Distinct players with a final result for this server and season, from every source we keep (our survey, final results sent to this site, community collection).

near_3.description: Of those, the distinct players whose final rank is inside 2.85-3.15%. Three of them confirm a server's 3% line (JP's is confirmed by the official last-day line instead).

line.description: The season's 3% line. confirmed false: read from fewer than three results near 3%, so no forecast is graded against it.

points.description: The results the curve is drawn through, one per result with a % rank. Only when at least five distinct players are inside 2.5-3.5%.

cells.description: The tier table: the damage at each published percentile on the server's curve through the line. extrapolated marks a tier beyond the results we have.

damage.description: 0.1B (1e8) units, the unit every document uses.

utc.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, with a Z suffix.
